video_title: Jaylen Brown trying to recruit LeBron James to 76ers with IShowSpeed

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown discusses his trade and recruitment of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I just got traded. We got to recruit LeBron. You got to tell LeBron he got to pull up.

text_blocks.speaker: IShowSpeed
text_blocks.text: Oh yeah, you left Boston. Where you going?

text_blocks.speaker: IShowSpeed
text_blocks.text: You going to Philly? You going to tell them to pick me up, bro?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: That's a crazy business, bro. Don't become a basketball player. There's no loyalty.

text_blocks.speaker: IShowSpeed
text_blocks.text: What happened? You just got traded?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: That's a good question. I think a lot of people want to hear that. I don't know. I just got packed up. We got to recruit LeBron. You got to tell LeBron he got to pull up. Pull up to Philly.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown discusses the 76ers roster and LeBron James' future
quotes.excerpt: We got Maxey, Embiid, BJ Boston. I'm looking forward to it. LeBron is going to make his decision soon.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: We got Maxey, Embiid, BJ Boston. I'm looking forward to it. I won't be seeing you streaming at the basketball games. We got to get you at the basketball game.

text_blocks.speaker: IShowSpeed
text_blocks.text: I got to get me. You got to get me there.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: LeBron is going to make his decision soon, so we got to recruit him.

text_blocks.speaker: IShowSpeed
text_blocks.text: Where do you think LeBron going?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: He's going to Philly, bro. He's going to Philly trying to get a ring.
